statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope
The symptoms are suggestive of supraventricular tachycardia and sick sinus syndrome
The symptoms are paroxysmal in nature
Continuous rhythm correlation over an extended period is needed
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to capture arrhythmic events and guide further management
Diagnosis codes I49.9, I47.1, and I49.5 were submitted
The denial reason code is PR-204
CPT 93229 is medically necessary for this patient
